thermal_input: prescribed uniform temperature; load index is not physical time
material: Constant equilibrium modulus k0, no recovery: limiting elastic verification only
selection: For g=0.02 mm compare three different mount idealisations. No fitted values. Free thermal expansion before contact is the analytical comparator.
